query: Anthropic message guardrails drop image blocks whose source type is url. Forward URL sources as URL strings, including images nested in tool results. For base64 sources with media_type, supply a data URL preserving that MIME type; keep raw base64 as a fallback when media_type is absent. Ignore malformed sources and unsupported file sources. Preserve the original message content.

The Anthropic /v1/messages compatibility bridge loses document blocks inside tool_result content. Translate supported document blocks using the same document handling as ordinary user content, preserving mixed text and document content.

Fix Bedrock Converse request mapping: request-level configuration such as guardrailConfig and performanceConfig must not also appear inside inferenceConfig. Preserve guarded-text behavior and ordinary inference parameters.

DashScope rerank calls should use the native text-rerank service path rather than the OpenAI-compatible path. Fix DashScope and its Qwen brand aliases while respecting explicitly configured API bases and existing chat behavior.

Databricks chat responses can carry thinking in reasoning_content, its reasoning alias, structured reasoning content blocks, or <think> tags inside string content. Preserve reasoning_content and visible answer text in normal and streaming responses, including reasoning-only chunks. Existing structured reasoning blocks take precedence over top-level fields. A string with <think> tags must separate reasoning from the visible answer. Preserve existing tool and citation behavior.

Treat an explicit empty choices list as a valid upstream response, including in shared dictionary-to-response conversion, sync/async conversion to streaming, stream response construction and the Anthropic compatibility adapter. Return an empty choices list without raising APIError or IndexError and without fabricating an assistant choice. Preserve usage-only responses. Missing choices and choices of the wrong type (including null) remain malformed and should raise APIError with a useful diagnostic identifying choices and the supplied type. Existing tests that deliberately reject [] encode the old behavior and must be updated for this change.

Router candidate deployment IDs must resolve unprefixed model names against provider-qualified wildcard deployments. Use the router's existing resolution semantics, preserving direct group names and team-scoped resolution.

A per-request routing_strategy override registers its selector in global callbacks and affects unrelated requests. Isolate override selectors while retaining their per-call rate-limit accounting across sync, async and pass-through routing.

Team member budget enforcement allows a request at the exact cap and can lose enforcement after Redis counters expire. Enforce the boundary and retain correct accumulated spend when rebuilding expired counters. Preserve ordinary team/user budget behavior.

Vertex requests fail when api_base ends with /v1 or /v1beta1: the generated URL omits project, location and model. Make these version-only bases work for streaming and non-streaming requests. Preserve bare hosts, full custom paths and Gemini behavior.

1) MCPServer.advertises_gateway_authorization_server (public property): when auth_type == oauth2, return True only if the server is gateway-managed oauth2 and does not use the per-server oauth relay. For other OAuth-family modes (e.g. oauth2_id_jag, oauth_delegate, true_passthrough) return False.
